notes: The he of he was thirty and five years old resumes the written Jehoshaphat standing earlier in the verse and belongs to that name's discontinuous unit rather than being added (rule 25).
בֶּן takes the English old with the construction-supplied copula, discontinuous around the numeral and counted noun (rules 20, 58).
Each שָׁנָה stands in a clause of its own and is rendered by its own years, so rule 22's tail-to-tail distribution does not arise.
